text:
Rae (Design): quick sync on tokens UI — want to make visibility explicit at creation without adding friction.
Hector (PM): one-line ask: fewer 'where did my token go' tickets.
Pri (Eng): current flow shows secret once in drawer. if we need 'recorded' option, backend must persist secrets + audit. mark infra.
June (A11y): make 'shown once' part of the label. use aria-live for reveal and ensure focus returns to token row after close.
Rae (Design): proposed compact row under name: Visibility: ( ) Ephemeral — shown once   ( ) Recorded — stored & auditable. default Ephemeral. small tooltip on Recorded: 'Access by team admins is logged'.
Hector (PM): default Ephemeral ok. add docs link in toast: 'Learn about token lifecycle'.
Pri (Eng): noted. Recorded => vault + audit events. We'll emit `token.created.recorded`. Estimate after mocks.
Rae (Design): microcopy swaps: replace 'Show secret' with 'Copy token (shown once)'; secondary 'Download .env (contains token)'.
June (A11y): when copying, announce 'Token copied to clipboard'. ensure download announces filename. toast should have persistent close.
Hector (PM): rotation UX: add toggle in rotate modal 'Keep old token active (grace)'. default off; if on default 24h soft-revoke. show inline risk tag: 'Increases attack window'.
Pri (Eng): implementable. we'll log `token.revoked.soft` vs `.hard`. per-org config possible.
June (A11y): modal focus lands on confirm. toggles use checkbox semantics with aria-describedby. tooltips keyboard-focusable.
Rae (Design): revoke copy: 'Revoke token — immediately disables clients. Undo available for X hours.' show X based on soft/hard.
infra-bot: infra-bot: "Flagging epic-512: token-visibility -> KMS + audit-store review required."
Hector (PM): action items: Rae posts two small frames (inline vs modal), Pri gives backend estimate, June provides checklist, I'll schedule security sign-off.
Rae (Design): will post frames in channel in ~45m. :sparkles:
